complex_predicates.name: Telic Completive Vector Verb ('phela')

host_element.form: Conjunctive participle in -e (e.g. kheye, pore, likhe)

complex_predicates.aspectual_or_semantic_contribution: Encodes telic completion, irreversible finality, or rapid discharge of the pole event.
complex_predicates.notes: Very common in colloquial and literary BDSB.

complex_predicates.name: Self-Benefactive Vector Verb ('neoa')

host_element.form: Conjunctive participle in -e (e.g. kine, dekhe, bhebe)

complex_predicates.aspectual_or_semantic_contribution: Indicates subject-oriented self-benefaction, introspection, or self-absorption.

complex_predicates.name: Other-Benefactive Vector Verb ('dewa')

host_element.form: Conjunctive participle in -e (e.g. likhe, pathiye, bujhiye)

complex_predicates.aspectual_or_semantic_contribution: Encodes action directed toward an external recipient or other-benefactive outcome.

complex_predicates.name: Sudden Inceptive Vector Verb ('utha')

host_element.form: Conjunctive participle in -e (e.g. heshe, kende, chomke)

complex_predicates.aspectual_or_semantic_contribution: Denotes sudden, explosive inception, or spontaneous emergence.

complex_predicates.name: Inadvertent / Adversative Vector Verb ('bosha')
complex_predicates.aspectual_or_semantic_contribution: Encodes rash, ill-advised, obstinate, or inadvertent action with unexpected consequences.

complex_predicates.name: Transitive Light Verb Construction ('kora')

host_element.form: Nominal or verbal noun host (e.g. kaj, proshno, opeksha)

complex_predicates.aspectual_or_semantic_contribution: Projects an agentive transitive event structure with nominal lexical head.
complex_predicates.notes: Core transitive predicate former in Bangla.

complex_predicates.name: Intransitive / Inchoative Light Verb Construction ('howa')

host_element.form: Nominal or adjectival host (e.g. shuru, shesh, bhul)

complex_predicates.aspectual_or_semantic_contribution: Projects an intransitive/inchoative event representing state change or occurrence.

complex_predicates.name: Experiencer Light Verb Construction ('paowa')
